actor.pricing_summary: Pay per event. On 2026-10-27 the active schedule started 2026-10-15. FREE-plan prices: actor start $0.00005 per GB (minimum one), car $0.0015, availability $0.0009. Details, host, and review events stay off in these templates. A replacement schedule starts 2026-10-31.

validation.evidence_summary: Imported from the portable workflow into n8n 2.1.4. Two executions on one data table stored a baseline and then alerted a 40 to 55 change while a second car stayed unchanged. A 12-car paged fixture stored 12 baseline rows. Shared failure and pagination branches were executed on the export workflow.
